claims.text: The FDA phenobarbital label says concomitant alcohol may produce additive CNS depression.
claims.quote: The concomitant use of alcohol or other CNS depressants may produce additive CNS depressant effects.

claims.text: The French label says alcohol increases phenobarbital's sedative effect.

headline.text: The FDA phenobarbital label describes additive CNS depression with alcohol.

reported.text: The French label also describes increased sedation with alcohol and phenobarbital.

mechanism.text: The FDA label describes the depressant effects as additive.
